summary: The 3D render style captures a clean, bright aesthetic consistent with cartoon models. However, several visual elements fail to match the spoken audio, such as missing characters and key visual effects.

clean: Character positions and living room background layout remain consistent across shots.
First-person perspective arm correctly holds and receives the mate gourd.
unclean: shot 3: Steam effect is missing despite text describing locomotive-like smoke.
shot 4: No dog is visible in the frame even though the text explicitly mentions one.
shot 5: Burnt tongue reaction is not clearly depicted on the character.

clean: Text overlays are readable and placed neatly at the top of the frame.
3D lighting and soft shading create a cohesive look.
unclean: shot 0: Characters feature an untextured white rectangular patch on their chests.

issues.problem: Missing steam/smoke visual effect for hot mate.
issues.fix: Add a prominent 3D smoke particle effect above the gourd.

issues.problem: Audio mentions a dog, but no dog model is present.
issues.fix: Insert a cartoon dog model looking at the camera.

issues.problem: White blank rectangle on character torso looks unrendered.
issues.fix: Fix texture map or remove placeholder plane on clothing.

learnings.rule: Ensure key visual props and characters mentioned in the voiceover are rendered in the scene.
